Definition: to amass, i.e. grow turgid; specifically, to array an army against
BiblicalUsage: tsâbâh describes to amass, i.e. grow turgid. It appears 2 times in Scripture, including Numbers 5:22 and Numbers 5:27.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsâbâh belongs in His Word because the idea it carries belongs there.
